<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency and Commodities:</strong> The Indian rupee faced pressure, trading near 95.17 against the US dollar, while gold prices reached a seven-week high as easing geopolitical tensions tempered expectations for US Federal Reserve rate hikes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Global Sentiment:</strong> Easing crude oil prices and hopes for Mideast peace are providing a cushion to domestic markets against broader global uncertainties.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
